n_93bb450c7a6c105e.name: Prepare the next email
n_93bb450c7a6c105e.source: export default function next({messages,previousState,attachment}){if(!Array.isArray(messages)||messages.length>10||messages.some(x=>typeof x?.messageId!=='string'||!x.messageId)||new Set(messages.map(x=>x.messageId)).size!==messages.length)throw Error('Invalid Gmail list');let state=previousState??{index:0,files:[]};if(attachment!==null&&attachment!==undefined){if(state.index>=messages.length||attachment.messageId!==messages[state.index].messageId)throw Error('Message association failed');state={index:state.index+1,files:[...state.files,attachment]};}if(state.index>messages.length||state.files.length!==state.index)throw Error('Invalid progress');return{state,more:state.index<messages.length,messageId:messages[state.index]?.messageId||'',files:state.files}}

n_8d8b0dd6bc37dee2.name: Select the first attachment
n_8d8b0dd6bc37dee2.source: export default function pick({expectedId,messageId,attachmentList,payload}){if(messageId!==expectedId||!Array.isArray(attachmentList))throw Error('Unexpected message');const a=attachmentList[0];if(!a)return{missing:true,remote:false,attachmentId:'',filename:'',mimeType:'application/octet-stream',size:0,inline:''};if(!Number.isSafeInteger(a.size)||a.size<0||a.size>52428800||typeof a.filename!=='string')throw Error('Invalid attachment');let inline='';if(!a.attachmentId){const found=[];const walk=p=>{if(!p||typeof p!=='object')return;if(p.partId===a.partId&&typeof p.body?.data==='string')found.push(p.body.data);for(const c of p.parts||[])walk(c)};if(a.partId==null)throw Error('Missing part ID');walk(payload);if(found.length!==1)throw Error('Missing or ambiguous inline part');inline=found[0]}return{missing:false,remote:!!a.attachmentId,attachmentId:a.attachmentId||'',filename:a.filename,mimeType:a.mimeType||'application/octet-stream',size:a.size,inline}}

n_c15c1dbbcedbbcaf.name: Check attachment bytes
n_c15c1dbbcedbbcaf.source:
import{Buffer}from'node:buffer';
export default async function stage({missing,remote,inline,transitUrl,size,messageId,attachmentId,downloadedMessageId,downloadedAttachmentId,downloadedSize,filename,mimeType},context){if(missing)return{attachment:{messageId,missing:true}};let bytes;if(remote){if(downloadedMessageId!==messageId||downloadedAttachmentId!==attachmentId||downloadedSize!==size||typeof transitUrl!=='string'||!/^https:\/\//.test(transitUrl))throw Error('Attachment association failed');const r=await context.fetch(transitUrl,{method:'GET'});if(!r.ok)throw Error('Attachment download failed');bytes=Buffer.from(await r.arrayBuffer())}else{if(typeof inline!=='string'||!/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]*={0,2}$/.test(inline))throw Error('Invalid inline content');const s=inline.replace(/-/g,'+').replace(/_/g,'/').replace(/=+$/,'');bytes=Buffer.from(s,'base64');if(bytes.toString('base64').replace(/=+$/,'')!==s)throw Error('Invalid base64')}if(bytes.length!==size)throw Error('Incomplete attachment');return{attachment:{messageId,missing:false,filename,mimeType,contentBase64:bytes.length?bytes.toString('base64'):null}}}

n_b9a97179fa14db9f.name: Prepare the next file
n_b9a97179fa14db9f.source: export default function next({files,previousState,folderId}){if(!Array.isArray(files)||files.length>10)throw Error('Configure the Drive folder');const i=previousState===null?0:previousState.index+1;if(!Number.isInteger(i)||i<0||i>files.length)throw Error('Invalid progress');const f=files[i];if(f&&(typeof folderId!=='string'||!folderId.trim()||folderId==='YOUR_DRIVE_FOLDER_ID'))throw Error('Configure the Drive folder');if(f?.missing)throw Error('Message has no first attachment');return{state:{index:i},more:i<files.length,name:f?.filename||'attachment',mimeType:f?.mimeType||'application/octet-stream',contentBase64:f?.contentBase64??null,parents:[folderId]}}

n_03e9a3b0f4f20bc0.name: Confirm Drive link
n_03e9a3b0f4f20bc0.source: export default function receipt({id,webViewLink}){if(!id)throw Error('Drive did not return a file ID');return {link:webViewLink ?? null}}
